figurative_meaning_en: to give someone the slip; to narrowly escape (especially from death, by defying or mocking it)
example_sentences_in_bangla: যমের দূতকে টু দেখিয়ে সে বেঁচে গেছে।
বিপদের মুখ থেকে টু দেখিয়ে পালানোর চেষ্টা করল।
example_sentences_in_english: He escaped death by showing the thumb to Yama's messenger.
She tried to give danger the slip by narrowly avoiding it.
history: Originates from Bengali folklore where showing the thumb to the messenger of Yama (the god of death) symbolizes a narrow escape from death, implying one has outwitted fate.
note: The idiom carries a humorous tone of relief in Bengali culture, often used in storytelling.
